relations.product: strategic alliance to jointly operate Mitsubishi Electric's automotive equipment business (Mitsubishi Electric Mobility; 50% stake to Foxconn's Lin Yin)
relations.quote: Lin Yin International Investment Co., Ltd. (Lin Yin), an investment management subsidiary of Hon Hai Precision Industry Co., Ltd. (Hon Hai Precision Industry) (Foxconn), and Mitsubishi Electric Corporation (Mitsubishi Electric) announced today that they have formalized a strategic alliance for the joint operation of an automotive equipment business. Through the alliance, the companies aim to develop next-generation mobility and thereby strengthen the sustainable growth of the Japanese automotive industry. Under the agreement, Mitsubishi Electric will transfer to Lin Yin 50% of its stake in Mitsubishi Electric Mobility Co., Ltd., which handles Mitsubishi Electric’s automotive equipment business, after which the two co-owners will jointly operate Mitsubishi Electric Mobility.
